entities.name: Query aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
observations: 355 aa protein with predicted molecular weight 36.98 kDa and theoretical pI 4.82.
Strong homology to reviewed aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenases: 70.1% identity, 96.9% query coverage, E-value 9.95e-155.
Contains Semialdhyde_dh PF01118 at positions 9–122 and Semialdhyde_dhC PF02774 at positions 145–332.
Probable enzyme is a homodimer and uses NADPH; exact substrate specificity is inferred from close homologs.

source_tools.relevance: Sequence analysis, Pfam domains, homology, and functional annotation

entities.name: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
observations: EC 1.2.1.11; catalyzes NADPH-dependent reductive dephosphorylation of L-aspartyl-4-phosphate to L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde.
Curated homologs are annotated with NADP binding, dimerization, and cytosolic localization; one Mycobacterium tuberculosis homolog is also associated with plasma membrane annotation.
Reference active-site annotations include an acyl-thioester intermediate and a proton acceptor.

source_tools.relevance: Curated Swiss-Prot homolog annotations and reaction evidence

entities.name: Aspartate-family amino acid biosynthesis
observations: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase is step 2 in the common branch leading from L-aspartate toward lysine, methionine, and threonine biosynthesis.
The product L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde feeds the diaminopimelate/lysine and homoserine branches.

source_tools.relevance: Pathway and GO annotations from curated homologs

entities.name: L-aspartyl-4-phosphate reduction
observations: Reaction: 4-phospho-L-aspartate + NADPH + H+ → L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + phosphate + NADP(+).
Mapped to Rhea RHEA:24284 and EC 1.2.1.11 in close curated homologs.
